verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's RTX 5090 page documents a hardware media engine ('ninth-gen NVIDIA Encoder' alongside NVIDIA Broadcast) and positions the card for creator workloads via 'NVIDIA Studio creator tools and technology'. However, these are thin marketing-level mentions with no codec specifics or app-level acceleration detail. Missing for 10: explicit AV1/HEVC encode/decode documentation, named creator-app acceleration (e.g. specific editors or renderers), Studio/ISV-certified driver details, and independent hands-on corroboration of encoder or creator-app performance.
